sidebar.title: Bots
new.title: New Bot
new.description: Give it a name, pick a look and tell it where to work. Say what it's responsible for in the chat or in its details later.
new.name: Name
new.computer: Its computer · working folder on this machine
new.computerHint: It works in this folder on this computer, on a separate branch for each coding task. Other computers can be chosen later in its details.
page.disabledDescription: Bots is a Labs feature. Turn it on in Settings › Labs.
page.emptyDescription: A Bot is a teammate that's always around: tell it what to do in the chat and it comes back when it's done.
header.computerLabel: {name}'s computer: this machine. View or change
composer.label: Message {name}
composer.followUp: Keep talking to {name}… it continues on the same branch
composer.busy: {name} is busy; new messages wait in line…
composer.hint: {name} works in the background, so you can leave. It lets you know here and in the sidebar when it needs you.
conversation.label: Chat with {name}
conversation.greeting: Hi, I'm {name}. Tell me what to do. I'll work on a separate branch and hand the changes to you to confirm.
conversation.greetingHint: For things I should always remember (what I'm responsible for, what to ask you first), write them into “Standing instructions” on the right.
card.queued: Queued; starts when the previous work finishes
card.reviewHint: Not quite right? Keep talking below and it continues on the same branch.
card.acceptApply: Accept and apply to current branch
card.applied: Accepted and applied to the current branch (branch {branch} kept)
card.accepted: Accepted; the changes are on branch {branch}
details.instructionsHint: Included every time it works: what it's responsible for, which repository, what to ask you first.
details.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. You review PRs in the pisper repo; fix small issues directly, otherwise only suggest; run npm test before concluding.
computer.title: {name}'s computer
computer.description: It reads and writes code and runs commands on this computer. Each Bot has its own.
computer.moreSoon: Later you can switch it to another paired computer (execution node) here.

waiting.question: {name} asks
